backend.license_rule: license is UNVERIFIED unless short single-line METADATA License or License-Expression is present; never inferred from classifiers/registries; full license texts withheld (withheld entries marked UNVERIFIED); no LICENSE/NOTICE published.

frontend.license_rule: license is the package-lock entry license field verbatim and citable to the lock file; UNVERIFIED means the lock entry carries no license field; no LICENSE/NOTICE published.

notes: Do NOT publish LICENSE/NOTICE from these files.
Backend licenses are not lock-confirmed (no backend lock file). Frontend licenses citable to frontend/package-lock.json.
